products.name: 石墨笼架
products.lockedDesign: Graphite dark-gray elongated technical runner. Three open scalloped windows in a smoky translucent gray side frame, gray mesh underneath, gray cords thread through circular frame anchors. Heel-mounted smoky gray oval-shield badge with black two-part gate and a gray cord crosses towards side. Long rear oval sole pod with horizontal striations; separated graphite forefoot blocks; tiny burgundy seam near rear collar. No silver white panels, no full black flat skate sole.

products.name: 骨白叠层
products.lockedDesign: Bone ivory chunky multilayer runner. Curving vertical bone leather-look side strips with subtle sculpted ripples rise from sole to collar, cream fine mesh, thick long black-speckled cream rope laces, black small paired gate near lateral heel, tiny dark-red cross stitch below eyestay. Large complex cream/yellowed-bone tri-layer sole with almond-shaped arch insert. Broad round toe, cream outsole. No black sole, no gum brown, no bright silver.

products.name: 交织暗网
products.lockedDesign: Dark black/graphite low elongated web-wrap runner. Open black mesh entirely crossed by MANY long gray and black flat woven tapes, diagonally and across forefoot and beneath bottom edges. One firm black diagonal side strip with a thin muted brass edge. Dark translucent segmented low sole, prominent extended rear pod. Tiny gate on square gray tab at heel loop. Preserve entire deliberate wrapping system, no simplifying into standard laces or free spaghetti cords.

products.name: 雾影高帮
products.lockedDesign: Medium-high slim classic high-top. Smoky gray translucent/ripstop gridded-looking upper over LARGE low-contrast bone-gray elongated gate chambers repeating vertically with tiny faded red joins. Black smooth eyestay, black toe rim, black heel triangular reinforcement, ivory flat laces through round silver eyelets, thin black rear loop. Flat aged ivory cupsole with front diamond texture and black thin bottom. Preserve specific quiet translucent-looking monogram pattern; no black/gold ornate overlay, no zipper.

products.name: 门序高帮
products.lockedDesign: Tall black canvas/leather-look high-top. ONE large vertical elongated paired-gate chamber strip on lateral ankle runs from collar towards sole; very thin aged-brass outline and tiny dark-red center junction, black central slit stays open. Ivory flat laces, dark-brass round eyelets, faint warm contrast stitching, black smooth toe trim, blank black tongue patch, flat cream cupsole with small BLACK rectangular heel insert and black bottom. Preserve tall straight collar and distinctive existing long side emblem, no zipper, no extra repeating pattern.

jobs.prompt: Precise local correction ONLY to this existing six-view shoe contact sheet. In the TOP RIGHT FRONT view and the BOTTOM CENTER TOP view, remove the added gate-logo rectangular plaque from the FRONT TOE. Replace only that small plaque with the shoe's original plain curved graphite rubber toe bumper and mesh edge, matching the unbranded toe bumper visible in the first and second side views. The heel gate badge must remain untouched. All other pixels, tongue MOVERNO spelling, rear lettering, all logos elsewhere, soles, open side frames, colors, shoes, mesh, panel boundaries, background and framing MUST remain unchanged. Same 6 views. Never move a heel badge to a toe.
